input: one JSON object built by swot.swot_input() from the stored run: trend, stock, product (novelty concept and product profile), market (with research channel/content hypotheses and merchandising actions), limitations
output: one JSON object {strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats, promotions, differentiation}; quadrants are lists of 0-4 {text, basis}, promotions 0-3 {title, text, basis}, differentiation 0-3 {text, basis} (a stand-in while novelty leaves draft.differentiation empty), validated by swot.parse_swot()
